top.text: Do u ever read a sentence & feel the need to pause & process & soak it in, not bec it uses big words or flowery vocab or poetic metaphors, but bec it lands just right & encapsulates a feeling or a moment So Perfectly it makes smth in your brain spark?? Ghhgjh i love words TvT
top.translationZh: 你有没有读到某个句子的时候突然想要停下来细细品味，不是因为它用了什么高深词汇或者华丽辞藻或者诗意比喻，而是因为它击中要害，把某种感觉或某个瞬间表达得太完美了，让你大脑里有什么东西突然亮了一下？？啊啊啊我真的爱死文字了 TvT
